windowSelection: Predeclared first seven reporting days of January, April, July and October 2025 for three UK sites, plus the retained complete AirNow source window.
limits: This is a bounded corpus, not a representative estimate of provider reliability.
Unavailable source readings are not evidence of fraud or operator misconduct.
Published hourly file structure provides the experimental schedule; station operators have not certified our review windows.
No real-user adoption or time savings are claimed.
